{{Quote|I'm sorry to intrude, Viceroy, but apparently there is some problem with your shuttle. Eriadu Spaceport Control needs to speak with you at once.|The Human page to Nute Gunray|<ref name="Cloak of Deception" />}}
This '''individual''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[Aide/Legends|page]] at the [[Eriadu Trade Summit]] held in [[Eriadu City/Legends|Eriadu City's]] [[Seswenna Hall/Legends|Seswenna Hall]]<ref name="Cloak of Deception" /> in [[33 BBY/Legends|32.5 BBY]].<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''[[Cloak of Deception]]'' to [[33 BBY/Legends|32.5 BBY]].</ref> Before the summit could begin, the page approached the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] rostrum and informed [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] of a problem with his [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] and that [[Eriadu Spaceport Control]] wanted to speak with the Gunray immediately. Gunray complied and followed the page, along with [[Neimoidia/Legends|Neimoidia]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod]], and thus was not present when the entire [[Trade Federation Directorate]] was assassinated.<ref name="Cloak of Deception" />
